appBrief.title: Transparent docs sprint coordination settlement
appBrief.userPromise: Backers can see which signed commitments satisfy the docs sprint threshold before any release plan is drafted.
appBrief.userSurface: A transparent app brief that shows Stag, qualifying Intendos, Pack solver result, release/refund routes, wallet review needs, and missing production rails.
appBrief.notProduction: This is not Hashdag, Staghunt, private accumulation, or production market settlement.

solver.note: This toy solver handles transparent count thresholds only; it is not the monotone fixed-point solver described for full coordination markets.

runThisPack.title: Run a conditional commitment pack
runThisPack.userGoal: Backers commit only if enough compatible backers also commit.
runThisPack.plainLanguage: 3 signed commitments meet the threshold, so the app selects the release route for 100 TKAS instead of the refund route.

walletRequestNext.requirement: Create one wallet-standard settlement request that shows the selected pack, route, recipient, amount, and source commitments before signing.

steps: Review the selected release route and alternate refund route.
Export one wallet request for the selected route.
Replay accepted evidence before marking the pack settled.
runThisPack.expectedResult: 3 commitments qualify for 100 TKAS of transparent route amount.
runThisPack.nextUpgrade: Turn this route into a wallet-standard settlement request, then require accepted replay before marking settlement complete.

walletReview: show that this is transparent planner state
show expired or unsatisfied Pack state
show original Intendo and capital reference

missingRails.name: Opacity
missingRails.currentAnswer: All commitments and solver inputs are transparent fixture data.
missingRails.neededForProduction: Private or selectively revealed accumulation so participants cannot trivially front-run or infer hidden demand.

missingRails.name: Capital multiplexing
missingRails.currentAnswer: Each Intendo references one visible capital source and cannot safely reuse the same capital across competing Packs.
missingRails.neededForProduction: A rule set that prevents double use while letting capital back multiple conditional opportunities before one Hunt wins.

missingRails.name: Atomic Hunt execution
missingRails.currentAnswer: The current Hunt is a plan field, not a transaction path that consumes every qualified commitment together.
missingRails.neededForProduction: A transaction or protocol route that executes all selected commitments atomically or fails them together.

missingRails.name: Oracle / settlement
missingRails.currentAnswer: No external event oracle, dispute process, or final settlement source is wired to this brief.
missingRails.neededForProduction: A defined settlement source, challenge path, and accepted evidence model for events outside the transaction itself.

nonProductionBoundary: This is not Hashdag or Staghunt production infrastructure.
It does not provide opacity, capital multiplexing, atomic Hunt execution, or oracle-backed settlement.
It is a transparent app brief for wallet review and later settlement draft design.
nextArtifact: signed settlement draft or payload event only after custody source and wallet review are explicit
